name: potools
description: 本机文件工具平台 · Web 前端 + Rust/Tauri 桌面宿主
author: pohoc <po.hoc4@gmail.com>

scripts.package:macos: pnpm version:check && pnpm icons && pnpm tauri build --bundles dmg --target x86_64-apple-darwin && node scripts/collect-release-artifacts.mjs macos
scripts.package:windows:x64: pnpm version:check && pnpm icons && pnpm tauri build --bundles nsis --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc && node scripts/collect-release-artifacts.mjs windows x64
scripts.package:windows:x86: pnpm version:check && pnpm icons && pnpm tauri build --bundles nsis --target i686-pc-windows-msvc && node scripts/collect-release-artifacts.mjs windows x86
scripts.package:win7: pnpm --filter @potools/web build && pnpm --filter @potools/legacy-win7 sync-dist && pnpm --filter @potools/legacy-win7 dist
scripts.package:linux:x64:build: pnpm version:check && node scripts/assert-linux-build-host.mjs x64 && pnpm tauri build --bundles appimage,deb,rpm --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
scripts.package:linux:arm64:build: pnpm version:check && node scripts/assert-linux-build-host.mjs arm64 && pnpm tauri build --bundles appimage,deb,rpm --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
scripts.package:linux:armv7:build: pnpm version:check && node scripts/assert-linux-build-host.mjs armv7 && pnpm tauri build --bundles deb,rpm --target armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf
scripts.package:linux:ppc64le:build: pnpm version:check && node scripts/assert-linux-build-host.mjs ppc64le && pnpm tauri build --bundles deb,rpm --target powerpc64le-unknown-linux-gnu
scripts.package:linux:s390x:build: pnpm version:check && node scripts/assert-linux-build-host.mjs s390x && pnpm tauri build --bundles deb,rpm --target s390x-unknown-linux-gnu
scripts.check: pnpm version:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm licenses:check && pnpm rust:fmt && pnpm rust:clippy && pnpm rust:test && pnpm rust:check:wasm
